description: Search this company's outgoing invoices and drafts. Without start and end only the current calendar year is searched. Returns the matching rows (newest first), total_count and has_more. period_totals is NOT the total of the matching rows: it covers every issued invoice between start_date and end_date in one currency (period_totals.currency) and ignores q, state, pay, nav and paging. For the total of a search, add up gross_total over all pages of its rows, separately for each currency (rows can be in different currencies).

nav.description: What the tax authority (NAV) made of the invoice. ATTENTION = needs action.

offset.description: Rows to skip (for the next page).

pay.description: Payment state. OVERDUE = not paid and past its due date.

q.description: Text contained in the invoice number or the buyer name.

start.description: First issue date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give start and end to search another year.

name: search_invoices
title: Search invoices
